analysis.summaryJa: many・muchの量を増やすmoreが、形容詞や副詞の程度を一段上げる比較へ広がる仕組みを扱う。距離のfarther・further、年齢や古さのolder、thanを明示せず以前や別案との比較を表す用法まで、業務場面で判断させる。
grammarPoints: more＋複数名詞・不可算名詞で量の増加を表す
more＋長い形容詞・副詞で程度の比較を作る
farther・furtherで追加の距離を表す
通常の年齢・古さの比較にはolderを使う
比較級だけでも文脈上の基準との比較を表せる
visualEvidence: MOREの液体がmany・muchの量から性質のメーターへ注がれる中央図
goodからmore goodではなく、useful・carefulのゲージがmoreで上がる対比
比較級だけでも「以前より・別案より」と読めるという天秤の注記
commonTraps: 不可算名詞の前でmany moreを使う
長い形容詞へ-erを機械的に付ける
普通の年齢比較でelder thanを使う
比較級には必ずthanが必要だと思い込む
距離の比較でfarの原級をそのまま使う

questions.prompt: The branch ordered ------- brochures for the autumn campaign than it did last year.

choices.D: many

questions.translationJa: その支店は秋のキャンペーン用に昨年より多くのパンフレットを注文しました。
questions.explanationJa: 複数名詞brochuresの数量をthan以下と比べるためmoreを使います。

questions.prompt: Customers found the revised booking system ------- reliable than the previous one.

choices.D: much

questions.translationJa: 顧客は改訂された予約システムが以前のものより信頼できると感じました。
questions.explanationJa: 長い形容詞reliableの比較級はmore reliableです。

questions.prompt: The delivery van can travel ten kilometers ------- before it needs to be recharged.

choices.D: farther

questions.translationJa: その配送車は充電が必要になるまで、さらに10キロ走行できます。
questions.explanationJa: 追加の物理的距離を表す比較級fartherが適切です。

questions.prompt: This warehouse is five years ------- than the one near the harbor.

choices.D: more old

questions.translationJa: この倉庫は港近くの倉庫より5年古いです。
questions.explanationJa: 建物の古さをthanで比べる通常の比較にはolderを使います。

questions.prompt: The design team needs ------- information before approving the packaging.

choices.D: more than

questions.translationJa: デザインチームは包装を承認する前に、さらに多くの情報を必要としています。
questions.explanationJa: 不可算名詞informationの量を増やすmoreが必要です。

questions.prompt: After the update, expense claims can be processed ------- efficiently.

choices.D: efficiencer

questions.translationJa: 更新後、経費請求を以前より効率よく処理できます。
questions.explanationJa: 副詞efficientlyの程度を比較するmore efficientlyが正解です。

questions.prompt: The annex is located ------- away from the station than the main office.

choices.D: more farther

questions.translationJa: 別館は本社より駅から遠くにあります。
questions.explanationJa: thanを伴う距離の比較なのでfarther awayを選びます。

questions.prompt: Please review the warranty terms ------- carefully before signing the contract.

choices.D: more

questions.translationJa: 契約書に署名する前に、保証条件をこれまで以上に注意深く確認してください。
questions.explanationJa: 動作reviewの慎重さを高めるにはmore carefullyを使います。thanがなくても文脈上「今までより」を表せます。

questions.prompt: Since the position was advertised online, ------- applicants have contacted us.

choices.D: more much

questions.translationJa: その職がオンラインで告知されて以来、以前より多くの応募者が連絡してきました。
questions.explanationJa: 可算複数applicantsの増加をmoreで表します。

questions.prompt: The service rating is now ------- than it was at the start of the quarter.

choices.D: higher

questions.translationJa: サービス評価は今では四半期初めより高くなっています。
questions.explanationJa: 短い形容詞highは-er型のhigherで比較します。moreの機械的な付加はできません。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about additional office space.

choices.A: We need many space for the new support team.
choices.B: We need more space for the new support team.
choices.C: We need most space for the new support team.
choices.D: We need spaces more for the new support team.

questions.translationJa: 新しいサポートチームのために、さらに広い場所が必要です。
questions.explanationJa: 不可算名詞spaceの量を増やすにはmore spaceとします。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence comparing two proposals.

choices.A: The second proposal is practicaler than the first.
choices.B: The second proposal is most practical than the first.
choices.C: The second proposal is more practically than the first.
choices.D: The second proposal is more practical than the first.

questions.translationJa: 2番目の提案は最初の提案より実用的です。
questions.explanationJa: 形容詞practicalの比較級はmore practicalで、thanが基準を導きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about an employee’s age.

choices.A: Ms. Kato is older than her supervisor.
choices.B: Ms. Kato is elder than her supervisor.
choices.C: Ms. Kato is more old than her supervisor.
choices.D: Ms. Kato is oldest than her supervisor.

questions.translationJa: 加藤さんは上司より年上です。
questions.explanationJa: 通常の年齢比較ではolder thanを使い、elder thanとはしません。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a route’s distance.

choices.A: The northern route extends far than the coastal route.
choices.B: The northern route extends farthest than the coastal route.
choices.C: The northern route extends farther than the coastal route.
choices.D: The northern route extends more farther than the coastal route.

questions.translationJa: 北側の経路は海岸沿いの経路より遠くまで延びています。
questions.explanationJa: 物理的距離の比較にはfartherを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about customer feedback.

choices.A: We received much comments after the survey was shortened.
choices.B: We received most comments after the survey was shortened.
choices.C: We received more comment after the survey were shortened.
choices.D: We received more comments after the survey was shortened.

questions.translationJa: アンケートを短くした後、以前より多くの意見が寄せられました。
questions.explanationJa: 複数名詞commentsの増加はmore commentsで表せます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing a software change.

choices.A: The dashboard loads quicker more after the update.
choices.B: The dashboard loads more quickly after the update.
choices.C: The dashboard loads most quickly after the update than before.
choices.D: The dashboard loads more quick after the update.

questions.translationJa: 更新後、ダッシュボードは以前より速く読み込まれます。
questions.explanationJa: 副詞quicklyの比較はmore quicklyです。文脈上の比較基準は省略できます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence requesting extra advice.

choices.A: Please contact the help desk if you need far assistance.
choices.B: Please contact the help desk if you need furthest assistance.
choices.C: Please contact the help desk if you need further assistance.
choices.D: Please contact the help desk if you need assistance farther.

questions.translationJa: さらに支援が必要な場合はヘルプデスクへ連絡してください。
questions.explanationJa: furtherは「追加の」という意味で名詞assistanceを修飾できます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence comparing equipment.

choices.A: The replacement scanner is easier to operate.
choices.B: The replacement scanner is more easy to operate.
choices.C: The replacement scanner is easiest to operate than before.
choices.D: The replacement scanner is easyer to operate.

questions.translationJa: 交換後のスキャナーは以前より操作しやすいです。
questions.explanationJa: easyは語尾を変えてeasierとなり、thanがなくても旧機種との比較が読めます。
questions.focus: 比較基準を省く比較級

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about two buildings.

choices.A: The west building is elder but energy-efficienter.
choices.B: The west building is more old but most energy-efficient.
choices.C: The west building is oldest but more energy-efficient than.
choices.D: The west building is older but more energy-efficient.

questions.translationJa: 西棟はより古いですが、エネルギー効率はより優れています。
questions.explanationJa: oldはolder、長い形容詞energy-efficientはmoreを付けて比較します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a longer trip.

choices.A: How many farther is the client’s office from here?
choices.B: How much far is the client’s office from here?
choices.C: How much farther is the client’s office from here?
choices.D: How most farther is the client’s office from here?

questions.translationJa: 顧客のオフィスはここからあとどのくらい遠いですか。
questions.explanationJa: 距離の差を尋ねる定型はHow much farther ...?です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The revised form is more convenient."

choices.A: The revised form is the only form available.
choices.B: The earlier form was revised more recently.
choices.D: The revised form is easier to use than the earlier one.

questions.translationJa: 改訂版の用紙は以前のものより使いやすいです。
questions.explanationJa: more convenientは、文脈上の旧版を基準に利便性が高いことを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "We need more storage."

choices.A: We have more storage than we can use.
choices.B: The storage we have now is not sufficient.
choices.D: Our current storage is the largest available.

questions.translationJa: 現在ある保管容量では足りません。
questions.explanationJa: more storageが必要ということは、現在の量が十分でないという意味です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The satellite office is farther away."

choices.A: The satellite office is the closest building.
choices.B: The two offices are the same distance away.
choices.C: The satellite office is at a greater distance than the other office.
choices.D: The satellite office has moved inside the main building.

questions.translationJa: サテライトオフィスはもう一方のオフィスより遠い距離にあります。
questions.explanationJa: farther awayは比較対象より距離が大きいことを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Mr. Noda is older than Ms. Wei."

choices.A: Ms. Wei is younger than Mr. Noda.
choices.B: Mr. Noda and Ms. Wei are the same age.
choices.C: Ms. Wei has worked here longer than Mr. Noda.
choices.D: Mr. Noda is Ms. Wei’s elder brother.

questions.translationJa: ウェイさんは野田さんより年下です。
questions.explanationJa: A is older than Bは、逆向きにB is younger than Aと言い換えられます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The new copier uses more paper."

choices.A: It prints on larger sheets only.
choices.B: Its paper consumption is higher than that of the old copier.
choices.C: It has the highest purchase price.
choices.D: Its paper tray holds fewer sheets.

questions.translationJa: 新しいコピー機の紙の消費量は旧型より多いです。
questions.explanationJa: uses more paperは紙の消費量が比較対象より多いという意味です。
questions.focus: more＋不可算名詞の言い換え

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Please explain the procedure more clearly."

choices.B: Please explain why the procedure was canceled.
choices.C: Please speak to more employees about it.
choices.D: Please make your explanation easier to understand.

questions.translationJa: 説明をもっと理解しやすくしてください。
questions.explanationJa: more clearlyは説明の明瞭さの程度を高める依頼です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Sales rose further in July."

choices.A: July brought an additional increase in sales.
choices.C: July sales matched the previous low.
choices.D: Sales were first recorded in July.

questions.translationJa: 7月には売上がさらに増加しました。
questions.explanationJa: furtherは、すでにあった変化に追加の進展があったことを示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The instructions are simpler now."

choices.A: The instructions contain fewer pages than required.
choices.B: The instructions have never been changed.
choices.C: The instructions are less complicated than before.
choices.D: The former instructions were the simplest.

questions.translationJa: 説明書は以前より複雑でなくなっています。
questions.explanationJa: simplerはless complicatedと同じ比較関係を表します。
questions.focus: 比較級の反対語による言い換え

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The newer model is more durable."

choices.A: Of the two models, the recent one lasts longer.
choices.B: Both models were produced at the same time.
choices.C: The older model is repaired more often because it lasts longer.
choices.D: The recent model is more expensive but less durable.

questions.translationJa: 2機種のうち、新しい方がより長持ちします。
questions.explanationJa: more durableは耐久性が高く、lasts longerと言い換えられます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "We cannot drive any farther today."

choices.A: We should choose the farthest hotel tomorrow.
choices.B: We have reached today’s limit for driving distance.
choices.C: We can drive a little faster today.
choices.D: We need more drivers for today’s route.

questions.translationJa: 今日は走行できる距離の限界に達しました。
questions.explanationJa: not any fartherは、これ以上距離を進めないという意味です。

questions.prompt: The training room now has twenty seats, but thirty employees will attend. We need ------- chairs before Monday.

choices.D: more much

questions.translationJa: 研修室には今20席ありますが、30人の従業員が参加します。月曜日までに、さらに多くの椅子が必要です。
questions.explanationJa: 不足する可算複数chairsの追加量にはmoreを使います。

questions.prompt: The old invoice form was difficult to complete. The revised version is ------- user-friendly.

choices.D: much

questions.translationJa: 旧請求書用紙は記入が難しいものでした。改訂版は以前より使いやすくなっています。
questions.explanationJa: 複合形容詞user-friendlyの程度比較はmore user-friendlyです。

questions.prompt: The first rest area is closed for renovation. We will have to drive five kilometers ------- to reach the next one.

choices.D: farther

questions.translationJa: 最初の休憩所は改装のため閉鎖中です。次の休憩所へ着くには、さらに5キロ走らなければなりません。
questions.explanationJa: 追加の具体的距離を表すfartherが正解です。

questions.prompt: The south wing opened in 2018, while the north wing opened in 2006. The north wing is twelve years -------.

choices.D: more old

questions.translationJa: 南棟は2018年、北棟は2006年に開業しました。北棟の方が12年古いです。
questions.explanationJa: 建物の古さの差はolderで表し、比較基準は前文から明らかなので省略できます。

questions.prompt: Only one technician handled weekend calls last month. The company has assigned two ------- technicians for September.

choices.D: many

questions.translationJa: 先月は技術者1人だけが週末の電話対応をしました。会社は9月にさらに2人の技術者を割り当てました。
questions.explanationJa: 数値twoの後ろにmoreを置くtwo more techniciansが自然です。

questions.prompt: Several clients said the installation guide was confusing. The editor will rewrite it ------- clearly.

choices.D: much

questions.translationJa: 複数の顧客が設置ガイドは分かりにくいと述べました。編集者はそれをより明確に書き直します。
questions.explanationJa: 動詞rewriteを修飾する副詞clearlyの比較はmore clearlyです。

questions.prompt: The shuttle already travels beyond the convention center. Next month, its route will extend even ------- east.

choices.D: more far

questions.translationJa: シャトルはすでにコンベンションセンターの先まで運行しています。来月は路線がさらに東へ延びます。
questions.explanationJa: evenは比較級fartherを強め、「さらにもっと遠く」を表します。

questions.prompt: This is the third revision of the budget. Fortunately, each version is ------- accurate.

choices.D: more

questions.translationJa: これは予算案の3回目の改訂です。幸い、版を重ねるごとに精度が上がっています。
questions.explanationJa: 各改訂版を前の版と比べる文脈なのでmore accurateが適切です。

questions.prompt: The temporary printer is slow, so the team misses deadlines. We need a ------- powerful machine.

choices.D: powerfuller

questions.translationJa: 臨時のプリンターは遅いため、チームは締切に遅れています。もっと高性能な機械が必要です。
questions.explanationJa: 長い形容詞powerfulの程度を上げるにはmore powerfulを使います。

questions.prompt: The client moved its warehouse outside the city. Our drivers must now travel ------- than they did last year.

choices.D: more farther

questions.translationJa: 顧客は倉庫を市外へ移しました。当社の運転手は今では昨年より遠くまで移動しなければなりません。
questions.explanationJa: than節が移動距離の基準を示すためfartherが唯一適切です。
